## MarketUtils.toCollateralParams() function

Converts collateral params from a plain input or ABI tuple.

**Signature:**

```typescript
function toCollateralParams(params: CollateralParamsInput): CollateralParams;
```

**Returns:**

[CollateralParams](./midnight-sdk.collateralparams.md)

Collateral params with bigint fields.

## Remarks

Parameter details:

- `params.token`<!-- -->: Collateral token address.

- `params.lltv`<!-- -->: WAD-scaled liquidation loan-to-value.

- `params.liquidationCursor`<!-- -->: WAD-scaled liquidation cursor.

- `params.oracle`<!-- -->: Oracle address used to price this collateral.

## Example


```ts
import { MarketUtils } from "@morpho-org/midnight-sdk";

const collateral = MarketUtils.toCollateralParams({
  token: "0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000001",
  lltv: 770000000000000000n,
  liquidationCursor: 250000000000000000n,
  oracle: "0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000002",
});
console.log(collateral.liquidationCursor);
```
